definition_en: a lawyer in Britain entitled to argue cases in the higher courts
core_image: 穿过法庭木栏、起身陈词的黑袍律师
scene: 伦敦老法庭里假发白得像雪，他站起身来。The barrister rose to address the jury.
sceneCN: 这里 barrister 指「出庭律师」（第 1 个义项：可在高等法院辩护的律师）；句意：出庭律师起立向陪审团陈词。

collocations.phrase: call a barrister to the bar

senses.title: A court lawyer in England and Wales
senses.definition: a lawyer qualified to plead in the higher courts
senses.definitionCN: 有资格在高等法院出庭辩护的律师
senses.example: A barrister argued the appeal before three judges.
senses.exampleCN: 一位出庭律师在三位法官面前作上诉陈词。
senses.why: He is the one called within the bar of the court.
senses.whyCN: 他是被召入法庭围栏之内的人。

senses.title: Called to the bar
senses.definition: admitted to practice after qualifying examinations and Inn membership
senses.definitionCN: 通过考试并加入律师学院后获准执业
senses.example: She was called to the bar at Gray's Inn.
senses.exampleCN: 她在格雷律师学院获授予律师资格。
senses.why: The physical bar became the threshold of the profession.
senses.whyCN: 法庭的木栏成了职业的门槛。

senses.title: Distinct from a solicitor
senses.definition: a specialist advocate, as against a solicitor who prepares cases
senses.definitionCN: 专司出庭辩护，区别于备案的 solicitor
senses.example: The solicitor briefed the barrister for trial.
senses.exampleCN: 事务律师为出庭律师准备庭审材料。
senses.why: Two professions divided the labor at the bar line.
senses.whyCN: 两种职业以「栏」为界分工。

senses.title: Junior and senior rank
senses.definition: a rank within the profession, up to queen's or king's counsel
senses.definitionCN: 职业内等级，上至王室法律顾问
senses.example: After twenty years he took silk as a QC.
senses.exampleCN: 二十年后他获任王室法律顾问，改穿丝袍。
senses.why: Silk gowns mark the senior bar.
senses.whyCN: 丝袍标记出资深律师之列。

senses.title: Chambers and the Inns of Court
senses.definition: the professional rooms and ancient societies that train barristers
senses.definitionCN: 执业场所与培训律师的古老会馆
senses.example: The four Inns of Court educate barristers.
senses.exampleCN: 四大律师学院培养出庭律师。
senses.why: The guilds kept the gate of the bar.
senses.whyCN: 行会守着通往律师界的门。

senses.title: Figurative voice of the court
senses.definition: a person of notable courtroom eloquence
senses.definitionCN: 以出色的庭辩口才著称者
senses.example: His style is pure barrister, all polished clauses.
senses.exampleCN: 他的文风十足律师腔，从句修饰一应俱全。
senses.why: The robe stands for the speech it delivers.

senses.title: In other jurisdictions
senses.definition: the term used in many Commonwealth courts for the advocate
senses.definitionCN: 英联邦许多法域对出庭辩护人的称谓
senses.example: Hong Kong and Australia also appoint barristers.
senses.exampleCN: 香港与澳大利亚亦设出庭律师。
senses.why: The English word traveled with English law.
senses.whyCN: 英语法律走到哪，此词跟到哪。

senses.title: The barrister in fiction
senses.definition: a stock figure of sharp wit and formal speech in novels
senses.definitionCN: 小说中机智雄辩的固定形象
senses.example: Dickens drew barristers with wicked delight.
senses.exampleCN: 狄更斯饶有兴味地刻画出庭律师。

intro.en: Barrister is bar, the court railing, plus -ister, an agent ending: one who is admitted within the bar.
intro.cn: barrister 由 bar「法庭围栏」加 -ister「从事者」后缀构成：获准进入围栏之内执业者。

items.en: barra named a rod or bar.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语 barra 指杆条。

items.en: Law French used barre for the railing in court.
items.cn: 盎格鲁-诺曼法律法语以 barre 称法庭围栏。

items.en: English bar named both the railing and the profession behind it.
items.cn: 英语 bar 兼指围栏与围栏后的职业。

items.en: barrister was formed to name the admitted advocate.
items.cn: 十五世纪造出 barrister 指获准入内之律师。

items.en: The word now contrasts with solicitor throughout the Commonwealth.
items.cn: 今与 solicitor 相对，通行于英联邦。

note.en: Group one holds the bar family and look-alikes; group two holds the legal-profession field.
note.cn: 第一组收 bar 词族与形近词；第二组收「法律职业」义场。

entries.definition: an obstacle; from the same French barre.
a trade ban; from the bar word line via Spanish.
entries.definitionCN: 禁运；经西班牙语出自 bar 词线。

entries.definition: one who takes loans; from Old English borgian, no kin.
entries.definitionCN: 借款人；出古英语 borgian，词源无关。

entries.definition: the lawyer who prepares cases and advises clients.
entries.definitionCN: 事务律师；办案与咨询者。

entries.definition: one who pleads a case, especially in Scotland.
the American term for a lawyer.

normalIntro.en: barrister is bar plus -ister: the man admitted past the bar of the court.
normalIntro.cn: barrister 即 bar 加 -ister：获准入越过法庭围栏的人。

normal.cn: called to the bar：取得资格。
对比：solicitor 备案，barrister 出庭。
等级：王室法律顾问，改穿丝袍。

normal.en: Place: chambers at the Inns of Court.
normal.cn: 场所：律师学院的办公室。

abstract.en: Hear the wood rail click as the robe passes it.
abstract.cn: 听黑袍越过木栏时那一声轻响。

abstract.en: Barrister is the gatekeeper's opposite: the one let in.
abstract.cn: barrister 是守门人的反面：被放行的人。

abstract.en: Picture white wigs in a wood-paneled room.
abstract.cn: 想象木饰房间里的白色假发。

examples.en: The barrister cross-examined the witness for hours.
examples.cn: 出庭律师盘问证人达数小时。

examples.en: Young barristers wait years for a big case.
examples.cn: 年轻出庭律师要等多年才办上大案。

examples.en: She hired a barrister famous for tax appeals.
examples.cn: 她聘请了一位以税务上诉闻名的出庭律师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴里斯塔」——能站进法庭这道「栏」（bar）里的斯塔先生

root: 由英语 bar「法庭围栏」（出古法语 barre「杆」）加后缀 -ister 构成，指获准进入围栏内执业的辩护人；与 bar、barrier、embargo 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses stand inside the railing: the advocate, the call to the bar, the split with solicitors, the ranks, the Inns, the figurative voice, the Commonwealth reach, and the fictional figure.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项立于围栏之内：辩护人、资格授予、与事务律师之分、等级、律师学院、借代、英联邦用法与文学形象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the wooden rail of the court and the one allowed past it.
core.cn: 核心意象：法庭木栏，与获准越栏之人。

branches.en: Admission past the bar makes the advocate.
The rail also splits solicitor from barrister.
branches.cn: 同栏亦分事务律师与出庭律师。

branches.en: Rank and guild organize the profession.
Eloquence and fiction borrow the robe.
English law carries the word overseas.

intro.en: The barrister word is a single formation; its family lives in the bar- words of law and hardware.
intro.cn: barrister 是单次构词；其词族存于法律与五金的 bar- 词之中。

latinIntro.en: Law French and Late Latin barra supply the base.
latinIntro.cn: 法律法语与后期拉丁语 barra 提供词基。
